svg.title: The flight loop as wm-flight-wiring.edn declares it
svg.text: The flight loop as the wiring map declares it
Generated from holes/labs/M-wm-wiring/wm-flight-wiring.edn (1d97dee9, futon3c HEAD 56b932e2) by spike/wm_wiring_svg.bb; not hand edited.
A box is a source var the map pins; an arrow is a field with exactly one writer, drawn to each reader; lanes follow the flight's order.
The registered test wm-flight-wiring-test checks each site against the pinned source (futon2 c95c6453, futon3c 58f1a8cb) and expects 145 findings (2 to-do).

line.title: :owner-text: read by :r2-served-by-reading, written by no box (the owner's text, a constraint)
:relations: read by :r9-classify-target, written by no box
:source-pins: read by :r9-embedding-neighbour, written by no box
:min-cosine: read by :r9-embedding-neighbour, written by no box
:failure-kind: read by :r9-failure-classifier, written by no box

g.title: :r1-outer-cascade (not built: intended site) writes chosen-target draw-seed

svg.text: solid box: built component at its pinned var (48)
dashed amber box: declared, not built, drawn at its intended site (1)
dotted box: the row's registered test, a declared reader (19)
grey box: siteless component, exempt from conformance (3)
arrow: a field, from its one writer to a reader, both built (73)
dashed arrow: declared on a box not yet built (8)
purple arrow: runs against the flight's order, the loop closing (5)
grey stub: a field read that no box writes (4); green stub: the owner's text, exogenous (1)

Numbered rings: the exemplar trace the map records for M-autoclock-in, in order (loop-entry > r1-outer-cascade > flight-entry > dispatch > clock-in > r2-served-by-reading > r2-verifier > r6-cascade-lane > r9-selection-law > r0-enact-step > r7-flight-call > wc-checker > r7-increment > r7-fold > r1-outer-cascade). Boxes on it have a heavier border.

What this does not show: the prover reads sites textually, so a field's presence at a var is what is checked, not that the value flows; the eleven code shapes it cannot see are listed in WM-MAP-REPLAY-D. Standing findings (143) are generic keys the prover cannot scope per box.
